passages.title: Returns policy
passages.text:
RETURNS POLICY
You can return most items within 14 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as they are unused and in their original box. Electronics must be returned within 7 days. Sale items can be exchanged but not refunded. To start a return, go to My Orders and choose 'Return item'. A driver will collect it from your address free of charge. Refunds are paid to your original payment method within 5 working days of the item reaching our warehouse.

passages.title: Groceries at the touch of a button
passages.text: More and more families in Saudi cities now buy their groceries online. Shoppers say the biggest advantage is time: instead of spending an hour in traffic and in the supermarket, they can order in ten minutes from their phone. However, not everyone is happy. Some customers complain that fruit and vegetables are not always fresh, and others miss choosing products themselves. Because of this, several apps now let customers chat with the person who is picking their order and ask for photos before the items are packed.

passages.title: The office without walls
passages.text: When Al-Dana Insurance moved its Riyadh staff into an open-plan office last year, managers expected more teamwork and faster decisions. The walls had been removed precisely so that people would talk more. What happened was almost exactly the opposite. Within months, face-to-face conversations had dropped, and the number of internal emails had nearly doubled. Employees, it seemed, put on headphones to protect themselves from the noise and then messaged the colleague two desks away rather than interrupt them. The company has not gone back to private offices, but it has added small 'quiet rooms' and asked each team to agree on hours when talking is welcome. Early results are encouraging, although the managers admit they are no longer sure what the right design is.

passages.title: Why I ignore the stars
passages.text: Online star ratings look simple enough: five stars good, one star bad. Yet anyone who has booked a hotel recently knows the system is far less helpful than it appears. Because almost every hotel now averages between 4.2 and 4.8, the difference between a good hotel and an ordinary one has all but disappeared. Many guests only leave a review when something goes badly wrong, or when the hotel offers them a discount in return. My own habit has changed as a result: I ignore the score and read the three-star reviews instead. They tend to be written by people who are neither angry nor rewarded, and they usually tell you exactly what was good and what wasn't, which is all a traveller really needs.

passages.title: The meeting nobody missed
passages.text: Few rituals of working life are as widely resented, or as stubbornly preserved, as the weekly status meeting. Ask any team and most members will tell you the hour could be replaced by a two-line email. Yet when one Jeddah logistics firm actually scrapped its Monday meeting, the results were not what its staff had predicted. Productivity barely changed; morale, on the other hand, dipped noticeably. Exit interviews later revealed that newer employees in particular had relied on the meeting not for information, which they could indeed have read elsewhere, but for a sense of who was who and whose opinion carried weight. The firm has since reinstated a shorter version, though it now calls it a 'team check-in' – a change of name that, one manager admits, has fooled nobody. The lesson, perhaps, is not that meetings are better than we think, but that we tend to misjudge what they are for.

passages.title: Too old to learn?
passages.text: It has become something of a commonplace that adults are poor language learners, and that anyone who did not start as a child should resign themselves to a lifetime of embarrassing mistakes. The research, however, paints a rather more complicated picture. Children do enjoy a clear advantage in one area: accent. Given enough exposure, they come to sound like native speakers in a way few adults ever will. In almost every other respect – vocabulary, grammar, reading, even listening – adults who study seriously tend to progress faster, at least in the early years, precisely because they can draw on what they already know. What adults lack is rarely ability; it is time, and the willingness to sound foolish in public. The first can be scheduled. The second, unfortunately, cannot, and it is this, far more than age, that seems to separate those who succeed from those who quietly give up.

script.text: There's a popular claim that we only remember ten percent of what we read. It's a neat figure, and it turns up in a lot of training slides. But it does mean we should be rather more careful about the numbers we repeat.

items.stem: I ___ the report to Mr Chen yesterday afternoon.
items.rationale_ar: كلمة yesterday وقت منتهي في الماضي، فنستخدم الماضي البسيط sent وليس have sent

items.stem: We haven't seen Faisal ___ he moved to Jeddah.
items.rationale_ar: since تأتي مع نقطة بداية مثل حدث معيّن، وfrom هنا ترجمة حرفية لكلمة «من»

items.stem: If the flight ___ on time, we'll be in Dammam by six.
items.rationale_ar: في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع البسيط بعد if، وwill في الجملة الثانية فقط

items.stem: If I ___ a car, I wouldn't need to take a taxi to work every day.
items.rationale_ar: الشرط الثاني لموقف غير حقيقي: if + الماضي البسيط، ثم would في الجزء الثاني

items.stem: The customer ___ called this morning wants a refund.
items.rationale_ar: نستخدم who للأشخاص، ولا نكرر الضمير he بعدها

items.stem: Is this the laptop ___ last week?
items.rationale_ar: بعد that لا نعيد الضمير it، لأن that نفسها ترجع على laptop

items.stem: When I was at university, I ___ walk to my classes every day.
items.rationale_ar: used to + فعل أساسي تعني عادة في الماضي انتهت الآن

items.stem: Would you mind ___ the door, please? It's a bit noisy outside.
items.rationale_ar: بعد mind يأتي الفعل بصيغة ing دائماً

items.stem: I ___ dinner with my family when the electricity went off.
items.rationale_ar: الماضي المستمر لحدث كان جارياً عندما قطعه حدث آخر في الماضي

items.stem: Sorry, I ___ a mistake in the invoice. I'll send you a corrected one.
items.rationale_ar: نقول make a mistake دائماً، وليس do a mistake

items.stem: Our company has ___ business with Mr Chen's firm for over ten years.
items.rationale_ar: التعبير الصحيح do business with، وmake business ترجمة حرفية خاطئة

items.stem: Please ___ attention to the safety instructions before you start the machine.
items.rationale_ar: التعبير الثابت هو pay attention بمعنى انتبه

items.stem: Excuse me, can you ___ me how to get to the passport office?
items.rationale_ar: tell يأتي بعده الشخص مباشرة (tell me)، أما say وexplain فلا

items.stem: Could you ___ me SR 50 until tomorrow? I left my wallet at home.
items.rationale_ar: lend يعني تعطي شخصاً شيئاً مؤقتاً، وborrow يعني تأخذ أنت منه

items.stem: The meeting was ___ because the manager was sick, so we all went back to our desks.
items.rationale_ar: call off تعني ألغى، أما turn off فهي لإطفاء الأجهزة

items.stem: The new phone was really ___, so I returned it after two days.
items.rationale_ar: صفة ing تصف الشيء نفسه، وصفة ed تصف شعور الشخص

items.stem: Please ___ this form and give it to the receptionist.
items.rationale_ar: نقول fill in a form بمعنى تعبئة النموذج

items.stem: I'm sorry, I can't ___ the meeting tomorrow. I'll be in Dammam.
items.rationale_ar: attend الاجتماع بدون حرف جر، أما attend to فمعناها يتولّى أمراً

items.stem: You need a file from a colleague you don't know well. What is the most polite way to ask?
options: I want that you send the file.
Could you send me the file, please?
You must send me the file before the end of today.
items.rationale_ar: Could you ... please? طلب مهذب مناسب مع زميل لا تعرفه جيداً

items.stem: You phone a company and want to talk to Ms Al-Harbi. You say:
options: Is Ms Al-Harbi there? I want speak with her.
Could I speak to Ms Al-Harbi, please?
items.rationale_ar: في الهاتف نقول Could I speak to ...? وهي مهذبة وطبيعية

items.stem: The air conditioning in your hotel room isn't working. You call reception and say:
options: I'm afraid the air conditioning in my room isn't working.
Your hotel is very bad because the air conditioning stopped.
Is the air conditioning working, please?
items.rationale_ar: I'm afraid تجعل الشكوى مهذبة وواضحة بدون هجوم

items.stem: A colleague invites you to lunch, but you have a deadline today. You say:
options: No, I don't want lunch with you.
Thanks, but I can't to come today because of work.
Sorry, I am not free for you today.
Thanks, I'd love to, but I'm really busy today.
items.rationale_ar: نشكر أولاً ثم نعتذر بلطف: I'd love to, but ...

items.stem: Why has the training been moved?
options: The trainer couldn't travel that day.
The booking system isn't ready for the training yet.
items.rationale_ar: الإيميل يقول إن رحلة المدرّب من دبي أُلغيت

items.stem: What should staff do if they can't come on Tuesday?
options: Go to the next session without telling anyone.
items.rationale_ar: المطلوب إبلاغ حصة في الموارد البشرية قبل يوم الخميس

items.stem: Noura bought a dress in the sale, but it doesn't fit. What can she do?
options: Get a full refund within 14 days.
Get her money back within 7 days.
Nothing – sale items can't be returned.
items.rationale_ar: منتجات التخفيضات تُستبدل فقط ولا يُسترد مبلغها

items.stem: When will a customer get their money back?
options: 5 working days after the item reaches the warehouse
5 working days after asking for a return
14 days after the item was delivered
on the day the driver collects the item
items.rationale_ar: المبلغ يرجع خلال 5 أيام عمل من وصول المنتج للمستودع، وليس من طلب الإرجاع

items.stem: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why traffic in big Saudi cities is getting worse
How families can save money at the supermarket
Online grocery shopping and its problems
A new app for ordering food from restaurants
items.rationale_ar: المقال يتكلم عن انتشار شراء البقالة أونلاين وفوائده ومشاكله

items.stem: Why do some apps now let customers chat with the person picking their order?
options: to deal with complaints about freshness and choice
to help drivers find customers' addresses more easily
items.rationale_ar: Because of this ترجع على شكاوى الطزاجة وعدم اختيار المنتجات بأنفسهم

items.stem: Why is Maria calling?
options: to tell Faisal about a new departure time
to ask Faisal to pay the rest of the money for his ticket
to offer Faisal a hotel in London
items.rationale_ar: ماريا تبلغه أن الرحلة مؤكدة لكن وقتها تغيّر

items.stem: What should Faisal do if the new time doesn't suit him?
items.rationale_ar: قالت: إذا كان الوقت مشكلة اتصل بي اليوم

items.stem: What does the man decide to do?
items.rationale_ar: قال Today's better يعني اختار موعد الحادية عشرة والنصف اليوم

items.stem: What should staff who drive do tomorrow morning?
options: Park at the mall and take the bus.
items.rationale_ar: الإعلان يطلب الوقوف عند المول ثم ركوب الباص المجاني

items.stem: Why isn't the presentation finished yet?
options: The man is still waiting for some numbers.
The computer system in the office isn't working today.
The man has been too busy.
items.rationale_ar: ينتظر أرقام شهر مارس من سلطان

items.stem: How does the woman feel about Sultan?
options: annoyed, because it has happened before
worried that he might be ill
surprised that he is at work
items.rationale_ar: كلمة Again? بنبرتها تدل أن التأخير تكرر وأنها منزعجة

items.stem: All visitors' bags ___ before they enter the building.
items.rationale_ar: الحقائب لا تفحص نفسها، فنستخدم المبني للمجهول: must be + التصريف الثالث

items.stem: The leak ___ much earlier if someone had reported it.
items.rationale_ar: ماضٍ لم يحدث + مبني للمجهول: could have been + التصريف الثالث

items.stem: Daniel told us he ___ the contract the following week.
items.rationale_ar: في الكلام المنقول بعد told تتحول will إلى would، وthe following week تؤكد ذلك

items.stem: At the visa office, the officer asked me where ___.
items.rationale_ar: السؤال المنقول يأخذ ترتيب الجملة العادية بدون did ومع رجوع الزمن للماضي

items.stem: I wish I ___ that email to the whole team. It caused so many problems.
items.rationale_ar: للندم على شيء حدث في الماضي: wish + الماضي التام

items.stem: On the way to the airport, we stopped ___ petrol, so we were a bit late.
items.rationale_ar: stop to تعني توقفنا لكي نفعل شيئاً، أما stop getting فمعناها أقلعنا عنه

items.stem: We regret ___ you that your application has not been successful.
items.rationale_ar: regret to inform عبارة رسمية لخبر سيئ الآن، وregret informing تعني ندمت أنك أخبرت

items.stem: ___ the flight was delayed, we got to the meeting on time.
items.rationale_ar: Although يأتي بعدها جملة كاملة، أما Despite فيأتي بعدها اسم

items.stem: After five years in Riyadh, Daniel ___ driving in heavy traffic.
items.rationale_ar: be used to + ing تعني معتاد على الشيء الآن

items.stem: Can we ___ the meeting until Thursday? I'm travelling tomorrow.
items.rationale_ar: put off تعني نؤجل، وcall off تعني نلغي، وuntil Thursday تدل على التأجيل

items.stem: We need someone to ___ Lama's tasks while she is on leave.
items.rationale_ar: take over تعني يستلم مسؤولية عمل شخص آخر

items.stem: I'll ___ the problem with your account and call you back this afternoon.
items.rationale_ar: look into تعني يبحث في المشكلة ويتحقق منها

items.stem: We'll have to work late to ___ the Monday deadline.
items.rationale_ar: التعبير الثابت meet a deadline بمعنى ننجز قبل الموعد النهائي

items.stem: There was very ___ traffic on King Fahd Road this morning, so I was late.
items.rationale_ar: نقول heavy traffic للزحمة، وbig traffic ترجمة حرفية

items.stem: Thank you for your ___ while we fix the problem with our system.
items.rationale_ar: بعد your نحتاج اسماً: patience بمعنى الصبر، وpatients تعني المرضى

items.stem: The 20% discount is ___ to availability and cannot be combined with other offers.
items.rationale_ar: subject to تعني «حسب توفّر» أو «مشروط بـ»

items.stem: After months of talks, the two companies have finally ___ an agreement.
items.rationale_ar: نقول reach an agreement، أما arrive فتحتاج at

items.stem: The new parking rules will ___ everyone who works in the building.
items.rationale_ar: affect فعل بمعنى يؤثر على، وeffect غالباً اسم بمعنى التأثير

items.stem: In a meeting, a colleague suggests a plan you think is too expensive. You say:
options: That's a silly idea – it costs far too much.
I can see the advantages, but I'm worried about the cost.
I agree with you completely; it's perfect.
You clearly don't understand how our department's budget works.
items.rationale_ar: نعترف بالإيجابيات أولاً ثم نذكر القلق بلطف

items.stem: You emailed a supplier a week ago and got no reply. You write:
options: Why you didn't answer my email?
I'm just following up on my email from last week.
I'm following my email from last week.
items.rationale_ar: follow up on عبارة مهنية للتذكير بإيميل سابق

items.stem: Your online order arrived damaged. You write to customer service. Which first line is most appropriate?
options: I want to complain you about the item.
I demand my money back right now.
Please accept our sincere apologies for the damage to your order.
I'd like to request a replacement for the damaged item.
items.rationale_ar: طلب واضح ومهذب، أما accept our apologies فهي جملة الشركة وليست جملة العميل

items.stem: Your manager is speaking in a meeting and you want to add a point. You say:
options: Stop, I want to say something.
Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?
Excuse me, let me to say something important about this.
Wait, wait – listen to me now.
items.rationale_ar: Sorry to interrupt طريقة مهذبة للمقاطعة في الاجتماعات

items.stem: Why did employees send more emails after the move?
options: They were sitting further apart than before.
Managers asked them to write more reports.
They didn't want to disturb colleagues nearby.
The new office had no meeting rooms.
items.rationale_ar: النص يقول إنهم راسلوا الزميل القريب بدل ما يقاطعونه

items.stem: What does the last sentence suggest about the managers?
options: They plan to return to private offices.
They think the quiet rooms have not solved the noise problem.
They blame the staff for the problem.
They are less certain about office design than before.
items.rationale_ar: اعترفوا أنهم لم يعودوا متأكدين من التصميم الصحيح

items.stem: What is the writer's main purpose?
options: to persuade companies to build private offices
to describe how a plan had an unexpected result
to explain how to design a quiet room
to criticise employees for wearing headphones at their desks
items.rationale_ar: النص يحكي خطة كان هدفها زيادة الكلام فحصل العكس

items.stem: According to the writer, why are average scores not very useful?
options: Most guests give hotels one star.
Hotels are not allowed to see them.
They are too similar to show real differences.
They are calculated incorrectly by most booking websites.
items.rationale_ar: معظم الفنادق بين 4.2 و4.8 فاختفى الفرق بين الجيد والعادي

items.stem: Why does the writer mention three-star reviews?
options: to suggest a more reliable way to choose a hotel
to complain about hotels that pay for reviews
to show that most hotels are only average
to explain how online scores are calculated
items.rationale_ar: الكاتب يقترح قراءتها لأنها أصدق وأوضح من النجوم

items.stem: What can we infer about reviews written in return for a discount?
options: The writer does not fully trust them.
They are more detailed than other reviews.
Hotels have stopped asking for them.
items.rationale_ar: يفضّل مراجعات أشخاص neither angry nor rewarded، يعني لا يثق بمن أخذ مقابلاً

items.stem: What does the woman recommend?
options: launching on the first of June
delaying the launch for a short time
items.rationale_ar: قالت إنها تفضّل الانتظار أسبوعين بدل سيل الشكاوى

items.stem: How does the man respond?
options: He insists on the original date.
He asks for more data first.
items.rationale_ar: Fair enough تعني «معك حق، مقبول» فوافق على رأيها

items.stem: What is the main message of the call?
options: The customer must send the money again.
The money never left the customer's account on Monday.
The transfer is delayed, but no action is needed.
The other bank has rejected the transfer.
items.rationale_ar: التحويل خرج لكنه متأخر عند البنك المستقبل، ولا يلزم العميل فعل شيء

items.stem: How does the guest feel about the offer?
options: He refuses it and asks for a full refund instead.
He accepts it, but without enthusiasm.
items.rationale_ar: I suppose that'll have to do تعني يقبل على مضض

items.stem: What happens to a claim submitted after seven days?
options: It needs extra approval and may take longer.
It must be submitted on paper.
It is paid at the end of the year.
items.rationale_ar: قالت إنه لا يُرفض تلقائياً لكنه يحتاج موافقة المدير وقد يتأخر

items.stem: What is the main change?
options: Expenses will be paid more quickly.
Receipts must be sent as photos.
items.rationale_ar: الإيصالات الورقية لن تُقبل، ويجب تصويرها ورفعها عبر التطبيق

items.stem: Under no circumstances ___ share your password with anyone, including IT staff.
items.rationale_ar: بعد Under no circumstances نقلب الترتيب: الفعل المساعد قبل الفاعل، والنفي موجود أصلاً

items.stem: Not until the auditors arrived ___ how serious the problem was.
items.rationale_ar: Not until في أول الجملة يتبعها قلب: did + الفاعل + الفعل في الجزء الرئيسي

items.stem: ___ I found most frustrating was the lack of communication from management.
items.rationale_ar: What هنا بمعنى «الشيء الذي»، وتُستخدم للتأكيد في أول الجملة

items.stem: It was only when the client called ___ we discovered the error.
items.rationale_ar: تركيب التأكيد It was ... that ثابت، ولا نكرر when

items.stem: If I had accepted the job in Dubai, I ___ in a much bigger flat now.
items.rationale_ar: شرط في الماضي ونتيجة في الحاضر (now): would be + ing

items.stem: If Majed ___ so impatient by nature, he would have waited for the full report.
items.rationale_ar: صفة دائمة في الحاضر (by nature) مع نتيجة في الماضي: if + weren't ثم would have

items.stem: ___ you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact our office.
items.rationale_ar: Should في أول الجملة بمعنى If، وهي صيغة رسمية شائعة في الإيميلات

items.stem: ___ I respect her experience, I think she is wrong on this point.
items.rationale_ar: Much as بمعنى «مع أنني» وتأتي بعدها جملة كاملة

items.stem: Our new office is ___ from the cramped building we started in.
items.rationale_ar: a far cry from تعني مختلف تماماً عن

items.stem: Small businesses are likely to ___ the brunt of the new fees.
items.rationale_ar: التعبير الثابت bear the brunt of بمعنى يتحمّل الضرر الأكبر

items.stem: His explanation doesn't ___ water – the numbers simply don't add up.
items.rationale_ar: hold water تعني أن الحجة مقنعة ومتماسكة

items.stem: We are ___ optimistic that the deal will go ahead next month.
items.rationale_ar: cautiously optimistic تعبير ثابت بمعنى متفائل بحذر

items.stem: The decision was taken without any ___ with the staff it affected.
items.rationale_ar: consultation اسم بمعنى التشاور، وconsultant شخص وconsultancy شركة استشارات

items.stem: Delays in the supply chain ___ a serious risk to the project.
items.rationale_ar: نقول pose a risk أو pose a threat بمعنى يشكّل خطراً

items.stem: We tried for weeks to contact the supplier, but ___.
items.rationale_ar: to no avail تعني بلا فائدة، والباقي تعابير نفي لا تكمل الجملة

items.stem: Applicants must ___ written approval from their manager before travelling.
items.rationale_ar: obtain approval بمعنى يحصل على موافقة، وهي الصيغة الرسمية

items.stem: The rumours turned out to be completely ___; there was no truth in them.
items.rationale_ar: unfounded تعني بلا أساس، وunfunded تعني بلا تمويل

items.stem: In a report to the board, you want to sound careful rather than certain. You write:

The figures are definitely showing a slowdown.
The figures, maybe they show a slowdown.
items.rationale_ar: would seem to تخفف الادعاء بأسلوب رسمي، وprove وdefinitely قاطعة

items.stem: A senior client has written to complain about a delay. Which reply has the most appropriate tone?
options: Sorry about that – we'll sort it out ASAP.
It wasn't our fault, but we'll check it.
We regret for the inconvenience that this has caused to you.
We sincerely regret the delay and are looking into it.
items.rationale_ar: رسمية ومهذبة ودقيقة، أما regret for فخطأ نحوي

items.stem: Your manager wants a project finished in one week. You think that's unrealistic and want to push back diplomatically. You say:
options: That's impossible, and honestly, you must know it as well as I do.
Fine, whatever you say – one week it is.
I'm not sure that's realistic. Could we review the timeline?
I'm not agree with this timeline at all, I'm sorry to say.
items.rationale_ar: تعبّر عن الشك بلطف وتقترح حلاً مشتركاً بدل الرفض المباشر

items.stem: Leaving a long meeting, a colleague sighs and says, 'Well, that was a productive two hours.' He most likely means the meeting was:
items.rationale_ar: التنهيدة تدل على السخرية، فهو يقصد عكس كلامه: الاجتماع كان مضيعة للوقت

items.stem: Why did morale fall after the Monday meeting was cancelled?
options: Employees could no longer get the essential information they needed.
Managers began sending far more emails.
Productivity dropped and staff were blamed.
Some staff lost a way of seeing who mattered in the team.
items.rationale_ar: الموظفون الجدد كانوا يعرفون من الاجتماع من هو المؤثر، والمعلومات متاحة في مكان آخر

items.stem: What does the manager's comment about the new name suggest?
options: Staff prefer the new name to the old one.
Renaming the meeting changed nothing about how people saw it.
The new meeting is completely different from the old one in format.
Employees were deliberately misled by the firm.
items.rationale_ar: has fooled nobody تعني أن الكل يعرف أنه نفس الاجتماع باسم جديد

items.stem: How does the writer view the idea that adults are poor language learners?
options: as a new and interesting theory
as a belief held mainly by children
items.rationale_ar: يقول إن الأبحاث تُظهر صورة أكثر تعقيداً من هذه الفكرة الشائعة

items.stem: In the text, 'The first' refers to:
items.rationale_ar: ذكر شيئين: الوقت ثم الاستعداد للظهور بمظهر محرج، فالأول هو الوقت

items.stem: According to the writer, what most often stops adults from succeeding?
options: starting to learn a language only after childhood
fear of looking foolish in front of others
items.rationale_ar: it is this, far more than age ترجع على عدم الاستعداد للظهور بمظهر محرج

items.stem: What is the man's main concern about the second candidate?
options: She seemed to lack hands-on experience.
She asked for too high a salary.
She didn't seem to understand the theory.
She spoke for far too long.
items.rationale_ar: كان ينتظر أن تذكر مشروعاً نفّذته فعلاً ولم تفعل، يعني خبرتها العملية ضعيفة

items.stem: What do they decide in the end?
options: to offer the second candidate the job
to interview the second candidate again before deciding
to invite the first back, but keep the second in mind
items.rationale_ar: وافق على دعوة الأول، وقال إنه لا يستبعد الثانية تماماً

items.stem: What is the speaker's main point?
options: A widely quoted figure has no clear source.
Reading is the most efficient way to learn.
We remember ten percent of what we read.
Training slides should include more data.
items.rationale_ar: يقول إن رقم العشرة بالمئة منتشر لكن لا أحد يعرف أي دراسة جاء منها

items.stem: What is the speaker's view of reading as a way to learn?
options: He is certain it is highly efficient.
He says a study proves it is inefficient.
He accepts it might not be efficient.
He thinks it works better than slides.
items.rationale_ar: It may well not be تعني أنه لا يستبعد أن القراءة غير فعّالة

items.stem: What does the woman do?
options: She agrees to lower the price.
She asks him to order less.
She says faster delivery would cost them extra money.
She declines a discount but offers something else.
items.rationale_ar: I'd love to say yes. The thing is ... رفض مهذب، ثم عرضت توصيلاً أسرع مجاناً

items.stem: What does Maria suggest about the conclusion?
options: It claims more than the data shows.
It is too short to be useful.
items.rationale_ar: promises more than the data can support تعني أن الخلاصة مبالغ فيها

items.stem: The office is closed on Friday and ___.
items.rationale_ar: الإجازة الجمعة والسبت، والسبت بالإنجليزي Saturday

items.stem: Can you see Dr Reem on Friday?
items.rationale_ar: العيادة مقفلة يومي الجمعة والسبت (CLOSED)

items.stem: After going straight, which way does she turn?
items.rationale_ar: قال: then turn left يعني لفّي يسار

items.stem: The new branch in Riyadh is much ___ than the old one.
items.rationale_ar: الصفة القصيرة big نضيف لها er فقط مع than، ولا نجمع more مع er

items.stem: You arrive ten minutes late for a meeting. You say:
options: Sorry I'm late – the traffic was terrible.
Sorry for I am late, the traffic.
Excuse me for late, traffic was bad.
I'm sorry to be lately in traffic.
items.rationale_ar: العبارة الطبيعية Sorry I'm late ثم سبب التأخير

items.stem: A visitor in your office building looks lost. You say:
options: Do you want I help you?
items.rationale_ar: Can I help you? هي العبارة المهذبة والصحيحة لعرض المساعدة

items.stem: On a phone call, you didn't catch a number the client said. You say:
options: Sorry, could you repeat that last figure?
Sorry, I didn't hear well the number.
items.rationale_ar: Sorry, could you repeat ...? طلب مهذب وترتيبه صحيح

items.stem: What is the writer's main conclusion?
options: People often misjudge what meetings are really for.
Weekly meetings should always be kept.
New employees need more formal training.
items.rationale_ar: الجملة الأخيرة: المشكلة ليست أن الاجتماعات أفضل، بل أننا نخطئ في فهم هدفها

review.method: two independent blind reviewers (keys withheld), 100 items each
